hook: The computer alarms went off on the way down to the Moon.
narration: Computer alarms kept going off as they flew down to the Moon.
July twentieth, 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin, in the lunar module Eagle, dropping toward the Sea of Tranquility.
Warning lights blinked on as the computer struggled to keep up, but the status stayed go.
Armstrong asked for a reading on the twelve oh two program alarm. Houston told them to keep going.
The lander's single descent engine had to slow them from orbit all the way down to the landing site.
In the final seconds, the engine kicked lunar dust across the ground below.
outcome: The Eagle landed the first men on the Moon, and Columbia returned all three astronauts safely to Earth.
